entries.name: Belgian FPS Finance cadastral building condition statistics, 2026 vintage
entries.provider: Belgian FPS Finance, General Administration of Patrimonial Documentation
entries.spatial_scope: Belgium; national, regional, province, arrondissement, municipality, cadastral division and statistical sector aggregates; no building-level insured-site claim
entries.temporal_scope: 2026-01-01 technical vintage; official catalogue metadata revised 2026-07-24; annual series
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Downloadable zipped CSV by type of built parcel, including totals, physical-condition indicators, central heating and pre-1900 construction; administrative and statistical-sector class summaries
entries.note: Publisher FPS Finance explicitly says ALL its open patrimony datasets share one licence based on CC BY and can be used commercially (https://finance.belgium.be/en/experts-partners/open-data-patrimony/datasets). The individual geo.be catalogue links a bespoke 'plan cadastral' PDF whose defined scope is cadastral map, so do not label the exact statistical CSV ZIP automatically as standard CC BY 4.0 or assert raw redistribution eligibility without reviewing the applicable licence text and attribution obligations. Original source catalogue gives 2026-01-01 ZIP and seven administrative statistical levels. Physical parcel counts are neither actual building or dwelling totals nor insured risk locations or replacement values. Freeze original ZIP bytes and source specification outside Git before any numerical model use.

entries.name: Belgian Statbel 2026 cadastral building stock and dwelling characteristics
entries.provider: Statistics Belgium (Statbel), using Belgian FPS Finance patrimonial documentation
entries.spatial_scope: Belgium; national and regional be.STAT tables, further administrative geography available in official bulk archives pending exact member and code list verification
entries.temporal_scope: Annual building-stock register as of 1 January reference year; online 2026 be.STAT view last modified 2026-10-15; archived yearly source files also available through Statbel Open Data
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Be.STAT 2026 building and dwelling counts by four displayed residential construction types, post-1981 age indicator, built-ground-surface bins, heating, bathrooms and parking indicators where applicable; machine-accessible yearly XLSX and TXT ZIP offerings
entries.note: Statbel explicitly states its Open Data use CC BY 4.0 and are usable commercially. Its official 2026 be.STAT table (https://bestat.statbel.fgov.be/bestat/crosstable.xhtml?view=43d7cdce-3647-4f5c-86f1-a4e0c864f692) was modified 2026-10-15. This counts buildings and dwellings rather than cadastral built-on parcels in the separate FPS Finance condition dataset; four displayed residential types are NOT a complete total of all insured buildings or business classes. Freeze exact 2026 ZIP/XLSX member and version, check administrative geography, suppression/blank bins, stock-vintage alignment and publisher attribution; no original data or inferred insurer coverage is committed.

entries.name: UK FCA general insurance value measures 2025 by firm and retail product
entries.spatial_scope: United Kingdom reporting firms and retail products; firm-by-region building exposure and insured-address locations are not supplied
entries.temporal_scope: Reporting year 2025; published 2026-07-21 and updated 2026-09-11; underlying fixed snapshot 2026-05-05
entries.resolution_or_granularity: FCA-published XLSX with product/firm level claims frequency, acceptance, average paid amount and complaints; market product-level claims-cost/premium ratios
entries.note: FCA source is the 2025 firm/product Value Measures publication, with direct provider XLSX at https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/data/gi-value-measures-data-2025.xlsx (publication/link verified, original XLSX bytes not obtained). Firm product reporting applies above GBP400k written retail premiums AND above 3000 in-force policies; home buildings/contents aggregate claim costs are 48 percent of premiums but individual firm statistics do not identify natural-peril claims, risk locations or TIV. FCA explicitly warns of home acceptance-rate reporting inconsistency and post-snapshot corrections. Rights to distribute/downloaded workbook require independent verification.
